name: fleetflow
description: FleetFlow - delivery planning and logistics management (YottaFlex AI challenge)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
